hooks.prompt:
Commit gate. $ARGUMENTS
If tool_input.command is not a git commit, return {"ok": true}.
Else run the Checks in .claude/skills/commit/SKILL.md from cwd, using the commit message from tool_input.command; return {"ok": true} or {"ok": false, "reason": "<step>: <last lines>"}. Do not commit, stage or edit.
